skills.detail:
Begin charging by holding down the skill button.
Continues to deal a mid-range multiple hit area attack while the skill button is held down. Continues to push away enemies within a certain area at mid-range. If you let go of the skill button before the charge has completed, the charge will cancel and you will attack normally. The charge has two stages, and when it has finished, you will unleash a different attack.
Increases damage against [Kozuki Clan / Kozuki Clan Servant].
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
This skill cannot be used in certain areas that have obstacles overhead.

Not Charged: Continues to deal a long-range multiple hit area attack with a Knockback effect.

Charged: Continues to deal a longer-range multiple hit area attack with a Knockback effect.

Double Charged: Increases own ATK. Continues to deal a longer-range multiple hit area attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to set enemies Aflame.
skills.name: Blast Breath

skills.detail:
When You Have a Treasure Area:
Continues to deal a multiple hit area attack in the areas around your captured Treasure (up to 5 spots) with a Knockback effect and a chance to set enemies Aflame.

When You Have No Treasure Area: Continues to deal a long-range multiple hit area attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to set enemies Aflame.

Deals increased damage to Runners. Become temporarily invincible after use. Acquires SPD debuff effect at Level 5. This skill cannot be used in certain areas that have obstacles overhead.
